meaning:
φθόγγος, -ου, ὁ
(φθέγγομαι), [in LXX: Psa.19:4 (קַו), Wis.19:18 * ;]
a sound: Rom.10:18 (LXX) 1Co.14:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
